title: Petrol, diesel prices today: Fuel rates in Delhi, Mumbai as crude oil extends gain amid bleak outlook on US-Iran deal
content:
• The last major price revision for retail petrol and diesel in India occurred on 25 May.
• Brent crude, the global benchmark, traded around $87.81 a barrel on Tuesday, gaining about 10% over the previous four sessions.
• Saudi Aramco postponed the restart of its 400,000-barrel-per-day Jazan refinery to 30 August.

title: US-Iran war LIVE: Trump flew secretly from Turkey due to Iranian threat —Report
content:
• US President Donald Trump announced sweeping new demands on Iran, including compensation for all people killed in conflicts, which will be put into future negotiations.
• A 14-point memorandum of understanding previously agreed between Tehran and Washington detailed plans for a $300 billion fund for Iran's rehabilitation and economic development.
• Oil prices extended gains for the third consecutive day, with West Texas Intermediate trading near $82 a barrel and Brent settling below $88, influenced by the US-Iran situation.

title: Trump signs executive order to space out childhood vaccines — What the new plan means
content:
• US President Donald Trump signed an executive order on Monday, August 10, seeking changes to federal childhood vaccine recommendations.
• The executive order directs the US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) to pursue revised childhood vaccine recommendations, specifically promoting the separation of the measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccine into three individual shots.
• Individual US states, not the federal government, determine school vaccination requirements, and the executive order encourages states to consider changing their laws to reflect the administration's revised recommendations.

title: William ‘insulted’ after Charles and Camilla reportedly asked Kate to change her name from 'Catherine': Report
content:
• King Charles III and Queen Camilla were reportedly involved in a suggestion for Kate Middleton to change her name.
• Kate Middleton, whose formal first name is Catherine, holds the title of Princess of Wales.
• In 2012, Prince William reportedly ordered legal action following the publication of topless photographs of the Princess of Wales (Kate Middleton) in France.

title: K-shaped economy is dead in US? Robert Reich points to McDonald's earnings — ‘Even CEOs are admitting...’
content:
• Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that weekly earnings for full-time workers at the 25th percentile rose 5.5% from a year earlier in the second quarter.
• According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics, the Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 3.9% over the same second-quarter period.
• In June, Moody’s Analytics chief economist Mark Zandi indicated that the K-shaped economy remained 'firmly intact,' with the top 20% of income earners, making more than $175,000, continuing to drive the economy.

title: Will India govt restore Old Pension Scheme? Centre says no proposal under consideration: Here's why
content:
• The Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) was introduced as an option under NPS from April 1, 2025, providing inflation-linked defined benefits and a minimum assured payout of ₹10,000 per month after retirement.
• Minister of State for Finance Pankaj Chaudhary stated there is no provision under the PFRDA Act, 2013, read with PFRDA (Exits and Withdrawals under the National Pension System) Regulations, 2015, to refund the accumulated NPS corpus to State Governments.
• India's fiscal deficit declined from 6.7% of GDP in 2021-22 to 4.4% in 2025-26 (provisional), and is estimated at ₹16,95,768 crore or 4.3% of GDP for 2026-27.

title: Trump Administration’s ICE detention crackdown puts US courts under severe strain as lawsuits surge nationwide: Report
content:
• The Trump administration's July 8, 2025, ICE memo, issued by then-acting Director Todd Lyons, expanded the interpretation of a 1996 immigration detention statute.
• Federal judges ruled against ICE’s detention tactics more than 16,000 times over the past year, with approximately two-thirds of these rulings linked to the July 8, 2025, memo.
• US District Judge Fred Biery of Texas reported his courthouse received 4,000 civil lawsuits by May, significantly exceeding its usual annual caseload of about 1,500.

title: India-SACU trade pact terms may be signed tomorrow
content:
• The terms of reference (ToRs) for a preferential trade pact between India and the Southern African Customs Union (SACU) are likely to be signed on August 12.
• The Southern African Customs Union (SACU) is a five-member bloc comprising South Africa, Namibia, Botswana, Eswatini, and Lesotho.
• Talks between India and SACU for a Preferential Trade Agreement (PTA) began in 2008.

title: CAG report flags fall in Delhi’s contribution to national GDP
content:
• Delhi's 2025-26 Budget is set at Rs 1 lakh crore, with capital expenditure projected to increase by 145% to Rs 28,115 crore from Rs 11,485 crore in 2024-25.
• The Economic Survey 2025-26 estimates Delhi's per capita income at current prices to reach Rs 5,31,610 in 2025-26, approximately 2.5 times the national level.
• For 2025-26, Delhi's economy is projected to have its Gross State Value Added dominated by the services sector (86.32%), followed by the secondary sector (12.88%) and primary sector (0.80%).

title: India, South Africa-led SACU group may ink terms of reference for negotiating trade pact on Aug 12
content:
• India and the South Africa-led SACU group are likely to sign Terms of References (ToRs) for negotiating a Preferential Trade Agreement (PTA) on August 12.
• The five members of the South African Customs Union (SACU) are Botswana, Eswatini (formerly Swaziland), Lesotho, Namibia, and South Africa.
• Bilateral trade between India and South Africa dipped by 13.55 per cent to USD 15.56 billion in 2025-26 from USD 18 billion in 2024-25, with India having a trade deficit of USD 1.55 billion in the last fiscal.
